Laboratory.cell: Institut de Physique du Globe de Paris
Laboratory.value: Institut de Physique du Globe de Paris

Target Material.cell: terrestrial rock; chondrite; achondrite; lunar rock — basalts, andesite, granite; CC, OC and EC chondrites; eucrite, angrite; Apollo basalts and norite

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Weighed powder aliquot — "An aliquot of <=125 mg of powdered sample was weighed depending on the Rb concentration of the sample; masses were calculated to yield >20 ng Rb"

Sample Preparation Method.cell: "Whole rock samples were crushed by hand using an agate mortar until a fine powder was obtained. A minimum of 0.5 g of terrestrial rock or meteorite and 100 mg of lunar samples was crushed in order to avoid non-representational sample analysis"
Sample Preparation Method.value: "Whole rock samples were crushed by hand using an agate mortar until a fine powder was obtained. A minimum of 0.5 g of terrestrial rock or meteorite and 100 mg of lunar samples was crushed in order to avoid non-representational sample analysis"

Digestion Acid(s).cell: HF/HNO3 attack: concentrated HF/HNO3; HCl step: 6N HCl

Digestion Step.cell: HF/HNO3 attack (concentrated HF/HNO3, closed Teflon bombs, 130 °C, >48 h); HCl step (after evaporation, 6N HCl at 130 °C to dissolve fluoride complexes, then evaporated to dryness) — §2.2

Digestion Duration.cell: HF/HNO3 attack: >48 h; HCl step: N

Final Solution Matrix.cell: spray chamber: 0.1N HNO3, 10 ppb Rb; APEX: 0.1N HNO3, 4 ppb Rb — §2.2–2.3

Sample Aliquot Mass or Volume.cell: <=125 mg powder, calculated to yield >20 ng Rb
Sample Aliquot Mass or Volume.value: <=125 mg powder, calculated to yield >20 ng Rb

Chromatographic Separation Applied.cell: Yes, DGA resin Ca removal (1.8 mL), then AG50 X12 (20 mL and 10 mL) in 3N HCl, then AG50 X8 (1 mL) in 0.5N HCl. Reduces K/Rb by a factor of 200 to K/Rb<2 and gives 88Sr/85Rb<0.005
Chromatographic Separation Applied.value: Yes, DGA resin Ca removal (1.8 mL), then AG50 X12 (20 mL and 10 mL) in 3N HCl, then AG50 X8 (1 mL) in 0.5N HCl. Reduces K/Rb by a factor of 200 to K/Rb<2 and gives 88Sr/85Rb<0.005

Isotope Dilution Spike.cell: N/A — no isotope dilution spike; mass bias handled by standard-sample bracketing or internal normalization

ICP-MS Type.cell: Multi-collector sector-field ICP-MS [all columns state "multi-collector inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometer"]
ICP-MS Type.value: Multi-collector sector-field ICP-MS [all columns state "multi-collector inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometer"]

Interface Cone Configuration.cell: Sample cone Jet; skimmer cone H
Interface Cone Configuration.value: Sample cone Jet; skimmer cone H

Desolvation System.cell: spray chamber: none; APEX: APEX desolvating introduction system — the APEX 'routinely yielded lower precisions (by ~0.03‰)'

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Masses.cell: 85Rb, 87Rb → Rb; 84Sr, 86Sr, 88Sr → none — Table 2; 'Strontium was monitored using the 88Sr ion beams'

Reported Variables and Units.cell: δ87Rb — ‰ relative to the bracketing standard (Eq. 1)

Collector Configuration.cell: 84Sr: L2; 85Rb: L1; 86Sr: C; 87Rb: H1 (with 87Sr); 88Sr: H2 — Table 2

Analysis Sequence.cell: Standard-sample bracketing; an external pure Rb ICP-MS solution "analyzed as an external standard during each analytical session to monitor the reproducibility"
Analysis Sequence.value: Standard-sample bracketing; an external pure Rb ICP-MS solution "analyzed as an external standard during each analytical session to monitor the reproducibility"

Internal Standard Element.cell: N/A — mass bias corrected by standard-sample bracketing, internal normalization or a double spike rather than by an added internal standard element

Internal Standard Concentration.cell: N/A — no added internal standard element

Acquisition Pass.cell: spray chamber; APEX — 'measured using both the spray chamber and the APEX sample introduction systems' in most cases (§2.3)

Doubly-Charged Species Monitor.cell: N — "double-charged Er or Yb isotopes" are named as interferences that the chemistry separates from Rb, p.2; no M²⁺ tuning monitor or production ratio is stated

Mass Bias Correction Strategy.cell: "Measurements were made using standard-sample bracketing to correct for instrumental mass bias"
Mass Bias Correction Strategy.value: "Measurements were made using standard-sample bracketing to correct for instrumental mass bias"

Internal Normalization Element and Isoto.cell: N/A — Rb has two stable isotopes; bracketing used instead

Blank / Background Correction Method.cell: Instrumental background measured at the beginning of and throughout each session (typically < 1 mV on 85Rb) and subtracted — §2.3
Blank / Background Correction Method.value: Instrumental background measured at the beginning of and throughout each session (typically < 1 mV on 85Rb) and subtracted

Interfering Species.cell: 87Rb: 87Sr; other: N — doubly charged Er and Yb are separated chemically (§2.2)

Interference Correction Method.cell: 87Rb: 87Sr corrected from the 88Sr monitor; other: N — final ⁸⁸Sr/⁸⁵Rb < 0.005

Uncertainty Level.cell: "the 2 standard error (2se) is reported unless stated otherwise"; for samples analysed fewer than 3 times, "the largest 2 se reported for a sample analyzed multiple times has been used"
Uncertainty Level.value: "the 2 standard error (2se) is reported unless stated otherwise"; for samples analysed fewer than 3 times, "the largest 2 se reported for a sample analyzed multiple times has been used"

Uncertainty Propagation Method.cell: δ87Rb: 2 se from repeated measurements, with the largest 2 se of a multiply analysed sample used for samples run fewer than 3 times — §2.3

value.value: 2 se from repeated measurements, with the largest 2 se of a multiply analysed sample used for samples run fewer than 3 times

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: N — no result-level rule is stated. Reported values are "averages of repeated measurements of each sample when multiple analyses were possible", with no criterion for admitting or rejecting a measurement; the "any ratio outside 2σ was discarded" rule acts within a measurement and is recorded under Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach

Combination Method.cell: δ87Rb: average of repeated measurements per sample, and averages per sample group — §2.3; Table 3

value.value: average of repeated measurements per sample, and averages per sample group

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: all [Rb: NIST SRM984 RbCl, with BCR-2 in some sessions]

value.value: NIST SRM984 RbCl, with BCR-2 in some sessions

Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.cell: Every sample (bracketing), plus an external pure Rb solution "during each analytical session"
Calibration Standard Measurement Frequen.value: Every sample (bracketing), plus an external pure Rb solution "during each analytical session"

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: BCR-2, AGV-2, BHVO-2, GS-N, SRM984 through chemistry, Allende, pure Rb ICP-MS solution — §2.3

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Between-Session (Long-Term) Analytical P.cell: pure Rb ICP-MS solution [δ87Rb: ±0.01‰ (n = 40)] — run as an external standard each session

Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Metho.cell: SRM984 through chemistry [δ87Rb: 0.00 ± 0.03‰]; Allende [δ87Rb: duplicate splits 0.12 ± 0.02‰ and 0.14 ± 0.04‰] — §2.3

Additional Notes.cell: Extraction voltage −2000 V; peristaltic pump 5 rpm (Table 1)
Additional Notes.value: Extraction voltage −2000 V; peristaltic pump 5 rpm (Table 1)
